hypotheses.paper: only one RP1 hyperbolic circle of holonomy <g> (l.927-928)
hypotheses.note: holonomy group read in G~ (lifted holonomy); in G = PSL(2,R) circles of every degree share <g> and are pairwise non-isomorphic (the degree is an invariant, GX.rp1Iso_iff_of_degree_pos). Proved in the G~ reading: GX.rp1Iso_of_zpowers_eq, standard axioms only.

hypotheses.paper: a real projective conjugacy between g and g^-1, preserving the orientation, permutes time-like and space-like components (l.928-930)
hypotheses.note: Reading OQ-116 (a) (open): time-like = i+ u i- in GX.BBS.IPm's time-like reading; space-like = Q(dsProj sigma) > 0. Under that reading: h in G~ (orientation-preserving projective transformations of RP~1) with h g h^-1 = g^-1, g the lift with a fixed point of A in Gamma_p minus 1 at p in dS2, maps time-like directions to space-like ones and back (GX.conj_inv_swaps_timelike_spacelike, through GX.timelike_spacelike_dir; standard axioms only).

hypotheses.paper: positive and negative hyperbolic (Gamma_p, l(p))-circles are not isomorphic (l.930-931)
hypotheses.note: Two readings. (1) Isomorphism = homeomorphism that is a (Gamma_p, l(p))-morphism, same p (GX.GammaLinkCircle.IsIso; SCOPE (e)). (2) Positive/negative is the l.915 form (g x >= x, resp. <=, on I+), not the primary repelling-endpoint definition of l.908-913; their equivalence is argued (fixed_structure, timelike_spacelike_dir), not formalized (SCOPE (f)). Positivity proved choice-free (IsSpacelikePositive.forall) and an isomorphism invariant (IsIso.isSpacelikePositive). Proved: GX.not_isIso_of_positive_of_negative, standard axioms only.

hypotheses.paper: this remark does not extend (l.928): a positive and a negative circle with the same holonomy group exist

sorries.obstruction: the examples are the quotients R/<delta^2 g~> and R/<delta^2 g~^-1> (g~ the lift with fixed points of a boost A in Gamma_p minus 1, through GX.exists_rayLift); a (Gamma_p, l(p))-circle on the orbit space needs GX.gxQuotient for the pulled-back structure on R and Orbits Z R homeomorphic to the circle; not built

findings: l.794-795 (space-like) and l.797-800 (light-like): 'L is a hyperbolic (resp. parabolic) RP1-circle' needs non-trivial holonomy. At p in dS2 or on the boundary of H2, Gamma_p contains no element acting as -id on l(p), so trivial Gamma_p-holonomy gives a central lifted holonomy delta^(2n), neither hyperbolic nor parabolic. Lean: the link of a regular point has lifted holonomy delta^2 (GX.regular_not_isHyperbolic; GX.not_isParabolic_delta_sq). That point is regular; the singular counterexample is the n-fold cyclic cover of l(p), n >= 2 (trivial Gamma_p-holonomy, lifted holonomy delta^(2n), real angle 4 pi n), argued, not built. With non-trivial holonomy the space-like claim is proved (GX.GammaLinkCircle.IsLiftedDev.isHyperbolic_of_deSitter); the light-like one is stated (isParabolic_of_null, tagged sorry). Smallest correction: 'with non-trivial holonomy' in both bullets. The time-like bullet (l.788-791) is not affected: central holonomy (e.g. the half-turn, lifted holonomy delta, RP~1/<delta> = RP1) is elliptic by l.693-694 and OQ-113 (d).
l.878: 'L=i^+(L) = i^-(L)=\emptyset' reads as L empty; intended 'i^+(L) = i^-(L) = \emptyset' (typo, not formalized).

l.927-928: true only if 'holonomy <g>' is the lifted holonomy group in G~; with the holonomy in G = PSL(2,R) the RP1-circles of degrees 0, 1, 2, ... all have holonomy <g> and are pairwise non-isomorphic (GX.rp1Iso_iff_of_degree_pos makes the degree an invariant; examples not built).
l.746-747: the parametrisation by (k, [g]) holds for every degree k, not only k >= 1 (GX.rp1Iso_iff_of_degree_pos carries no hypothesis on k). Not a defect.
questions: Isomorphism of (Gamma_p, l(p))-circles (l.931): read with the same p (a (Gamma_p, l(p))-morphism homeomorphism). An isomorphism through B in SO0(1,2) moving p to p' would preserve i+- and the orientation, so the conclusion is unchanged (argued, not formalized). Which notion is of record?
'holonomy <g>' (l.927): read as the lifted holonomy group in G~ (see findings). Accept?

i+-(l(p)) are as in GX.BBS.IPm: OQ-116 (a) timelike reading at dS2 is used for the time-like components; OQ-116 is open, so (ii) is proved under that reading. Under the causal reading the lightlike directions would be time-like and (ii) would have to exclude them.

prose_rows.claim: classification of RP1-circles (l.712-719); every cyclic subgroup is a holonomy group, and two circles are isomorphic iff their holonomy groups are conjugate (l.721-723)
prose_rows.note: The developed-image classification is closed (exhaust). l.721-723 is closed only in the oriented form of l.723-731: isomorphism iff the oriented lifted holonomies (elements of G~) are conjugate (rp1Iso_iff_conj). The printed group form (conjugate holonomy groups => isomorphic) is proved only for two equal hyperbolic groups (rp1Iso_of_zpowers_eq). The existence half is a sorry.

prose_rows.claim: elliptic circles parametrised by the angle
degree k >= 1 parametrised by (k,[g]); hyperbolic classes by |tr|; two parabolic classes
degree 0: parabolic positive; hyperbolic by a positive real; x0 repelling, x1 attracting
types by the position of p
degree-0 types: BTZ-like past/future, Misner, cuspidal, extreme BTZ-like
degree k >= 1: k even, components of I+-, positive/negative dichotomy (l.906-915, in the l.915 form), light-like (l.917-922)

kb_proposals: RP1-circles are classified by GX.rp1Iso_iff_conj (iso iff conjugate lifted holonomies in G~); its 'if' half descends Phi = D'^-1 o D through the periodic covers, after moving the developed image by GX.GTilde.IsComp.exists_add_int (components of {x < f x} are integer translates).

The universal covering RP~1 -> l(p) is GX.linkCover (t -> ray of theta^-1(e^{i pi t})), delta acts as the antipodal map; GX.exists_rayLift lifts A in Gamma_p to G~ (between two oriented theta, via linkToRP1_eq_smul); GX.GammaLinkCircle.IsLiftedDev.relate relates any two lifted developing pairs (E' = E o psi, D' = k o D o psi, f' = k f k^-1).

A hyperbolic A in SL(2,R) is conjugated to A^-1 by a traceless h anticommuting with A - (tr/2) I (GX.PSL2.exists_conj_inv_of_matrix, three cases b != 0, c != 0, b = c = 0); then GX.GTilde.IsHyperbolic.exists_conj_inv in G~.

Three fixed points of PSL(2,R) on RP1 force 1 (GX.PSL2.eq_one_of_three_fixed): the fixed-line quadratic form c x^2 + (d-a) x y - b y^2 vanishes at three independent vectors; the linear_combination coefficients are the 3x3 adjugate (sympy).

At p in dS2, an element != 1 of Gamma_p fixes only lightlike rays (GX.eq_one_of_smul_eq_of_deSitter, via PSL2.eq_one_of_three_fixed and the centre of SL(2,R)); its G~-lift moves time-like and space-like directions in opposite directions (GX.timelike_spacelike_dir).
Isomorphisms of GammaLinkCircles with C'.pt = C.pt: destructure C' and subst (GX.GammaLinkCircle.IsIso).
